title: Unnecessary Parameters (The Cluttered Signature)
pattern: A function parameter that is declared in the signature but never read or referenced within the function body.
why_bad: Forces every caller of the function to formulate and pass a meaningless value, increasing API coupling and cognitive burden.
detection: Function parameters whose names are unused (or prefixed with underscores) and are not required by any trait interface.
counterexample: Implementing required signatures dictated by an external trait or API.
fix: Remove the unused parameter from the function signature and update all call sites.
source: Fowler, *Refactoring*, Chapter 3 ("Speculative Generality - Remove Parameter"); Steve McConnell, *Code Complete*, Chapter 24.
